concerns.text: Task T001 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but later task T016 also writes to `quickstart.md`. Concurrent execution could cause write‑race conditions, so the `[P]` tag is unsafe.

Task T014 is marked `[P]` yet it modifies `code/main.py`. Task T015 (resource guards) also edits the same file, creating a shared‑state conflict if run in parallel. The `[P]` tag is therefore inaccurate.
Task T015 is tagged `[P]` but it writes to `code/main.py` (same file as T014). This shared modification violates parallel‑safety, so the `[P]` tag must be removed or the tasks serialized.
Task T016 is marked `[P]` yet it updates `quickstart.md` (also written by T001) and the project‑state YAML. These shared artifacts make the task not parallel‑safe; the `[P]` tag should be removed.
